title: AI4RA proposal-review highlight
description: Show how a research administrator turns one NSF proposal into a reusable, source-grounded extraction after an explicit approval gate.

capture.request: Using only the attached document, give the proposal title, requested amount, project period, and total equipment budget. Identify the source document for each fact. Name the reusable extraction "{{extractionName}}".

orientation.copy: A repeatable review starts with a source, a clear question, and a human decision point.

source.copy: Attach the proposal so every answer and extracted field can remain tied to it.

sourceAttached.copy: The proposal is now the shared evidence for the question and the reusable extraction.

request.copy: These are the facts staff repeatedly find and re-enter for every proposal.

proposal.copy: Vandalizer proposes a reusable extraction and stops for human approval.

approval.copy: The extraction is created only after the reviewer explicitly approves the proposed work.

extraction.copy: Now the approved fields are structured from this proposal and ready for the next one.

conclusion.copy: The next proposal starts with a reusable, source-grounded review process—not a blank page.

segments.purpose: Orient in the real workspace and attach the source.
Show the question being typed and leave time to read it.
Acknowledge the submitted request before its proposal appears.
Read the proposed extraction and its approval gate.
Make the explicit human decision visible.
Show the confirmation becoming a real product action.
Show live extraction work without retaining dead wait time.
Show discovery before the completed result.
Give the completed, structured result a readable final beat.
